reviews.title: Low maintenance, efficient, fast,
reviews.comment: This chip is the best one ever owned. Put it it in and forget about it. Doesn’t get hot and have never had a stability issue. No you can’t overclock it but just set bios to performance and get some fast CU-DIMM DDR5.  It runs CU-DIMM 8600 MT/S on my board and was effortless to set up. It anyone tells you that “6400 is the sweet spot” doesn’t know what they are talking about. Performance jumps up significantly with faster  RAM. Don’t wait if you can afford it. This chip isn’t hot and you will not be bothered by coolers. For me it’s perfect. It has let me build out very small SFF cases. The included cooler looks good and it is adequate to cool a 65 TDP. I did not think I would like it, but I do! Good luck!
